items: 【Computer & Tablet 2 In 1 Mode】 This tablet is the perfect combination of computer and tablet PC. Tablets with bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse and foldable protective case, it can flexibly turn tablet into a laptop mode. Help you open the office mode at any time.

【Performance Tablet with Keyboard】 2 in 1 tablets with 12GB RAM (4GB Physical RAM + 8GB Extended Virtual RAM) 64 GB ROM (1TB expandable). large storage space for your daily entertainment and work needs. 10 inch tablet with case, support bluetooth, FM, and Wi-Fi. Latest android 15 tablet with Powerful processor, 1.8Ghz quad-core speed, you can enjoy a smooth experience.

【10 inch IPS Display & Dual Camera】 10.1 inch tablet equipped with a high resolution 1280x800 IPS/HD screen which will bring you more realistic colors and clearer pictures. Dual cameras (8MP Rear+2MP Front), you can take beautiful photos and smooth video conversations.

【2.4G/5G Wi-Fi 6 High-performance】 The android 15 tablet built-in 6000mAH battery, a single charge of the battery can last up to 6-10 hours, perfect for long-distance commuting and travel, reading, watching movies, dramas, listening to music and so on. tablet with dual stereo speakers and fast-transmitting Type-c data interface support, 2.4G/5G WIFI network, enjoy faster and more stable.

【Package Include】 Package come with 1* tablet, 1* keyboard, 1* stylus, 1* protective case, 1* mouse, 1* cable. The 2 in 1 tablet contain complete accessories as a computer, can meet most occasion in daily life. it's a best gift for birthday and festivals.
